name: Pregabalin
description: Pregabalin (Lyrica) facts: uses for nerve pain, fibromyalgia and seizures, dosing basics, breathing warnings, misuse, withdrawal, and legal access.
quick: Pregabalin (Lyrica) is a nerve pain and antiseizure medicine used for diabetic nerve pain, shingles pain, fibromyalgia, spinal cord injury pain, and partial seizures. It is a Schedule V controlled substance because it can be misused, and stopping it suddenly can cause withdrawal.
facts: Diabetic nerve pain, postherpetic neuralgia, fibromyalgia, spinal cord injury pain, partial-onset seizures (add-on)
Pain relief within the first week
Breathing problems with opioids or sedatives

profile.onset: About 1 hour (peak); pain relief within a week

blocks.p: Pregabalin is approved for nerve pain from diabetic neuropathy, shingles (postherpetic neuralgia), and spinal cord injury; for fibromyalgia; and as an add-on for partial-onset seizures in people 1 month and older.[[1]]

It binds to a part of nerve calcium channels (alpha-2-delta), calming overactive nerve signaling. It is not an opioid, but it can cause euphoria at high doses and is sometimes misused, especially with opioids.

The figures below come from the FDA-approved label and describe how prescribers typically use pregabalin. They are not personal dosing advice. A prescriber sets the dose for each person and adjusts it over time.[[1]]

head: Condition
Typical adult dose

rows: 75 mg twice or 50 mg three times a day

sections.q: What are the risks and side effects of pregabalin?

blocks.p: **Common side effects** include dizziness, drowsiness, swelling of the hands and feet, weight gain, blurred vision, dry mouth, and trouble concentrating.[[1]]
**Serious risks** include allergic swelling of the face and throat (angioedema), breathing problems with sedatives, suicidal thoughts (a class warning for antiseizure drugs), and misuse.[[1]]

blocks.warn: The FDA warns that gabapentin and pregabalin can cause serious, sometimes fatal, breathing problems when combined with opioids or other sedatives, and in older adults and people with lung disease.[[2]]

sections.q: What does pregabalin overdose look like?

blocks.p: Pregabalin overdose causes drowsiness, confusion, agitation, restlessness, and, rarely, seizures or coma. Most deaths involve opioids or other sedatives taken at the same time.[[1]][[2]]

emergency.title: If someone may have overdosed
items: Call 911 if the person is unresponsive, hard to wake, or breathing slowly.
For advice when the person is awake and stable, call Poison Help at 1-800-222-1222 (US, free, 24 hours).
If opioids could be involved, including pills not from a pharmacy, give naloxone if you have it. Naloxone does not reverse pregabalin, but it will not harm the person.
Stay with the person and place them on their side if they are drowsy or vomiting.

sections.q: What is pregabalin withdrawal like, and how long does it last?

blocks.p: Stopping pregabalin suddenly after regular use can cause withdrawal. The label advises tapering over at least one week.[[1]]

timeline.title: Symptoms begin
timeline.text: Insomnia, nausea, headache, anxiety, sweating, diarrhea.

timeline.title: Peak
timeline.text: Restlessness, pain, and in people with epilepsy, seizures.

timeline.title: Recovery
timeline.text: Most symptoms resolve within weeks; longer after high doses.

blocks.warn: In people with epilepsy, stopping pregabalin suddenly can trigger more frequent seizures.

sections.q: How do you get pregabalin legally in the US?

blocks.p: In the United States, pregabalin is a Schedule V controlled substance. The only legal way to get it is with a prescription from a clinician registered with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), filled by a licensed pharmacy. Depending on state law, that can be a physician, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.[[3]]

ul: **Refills:** Schedule V prescriptions can be refilled as the prescriber authorizes. Some states set stricter limits.

**Telehealth:** federal flexibilities let DEA-registered clinicians prescribe Schedule II to V medicines after a telemedicine visit, without a prior in-person exam, through December 31, 2026. A permanent DEA rule was under final review in late 2026. State rules can be stricter.[[4]]
**Monitoring:** prescribers and pharmacists in most states check a prescription drug monitoring program, a database of controlled-substance prescriptions, before prescribing or dispensing.

**Pharmacies:** a legitimate pharmacy always requires a valid prescription, has a licensed pharmacist available, and is licensed in the state it ships to. The FDA's BeSafeRx tool and the NABP's safe pharmacy list help confirm a pharmacy is real.[[5]][[6]]
**Cost:** generic pregabalin is widely available and inexpensive.

blocks.p: **Traveling:** keep the medicine in its original pharmacy container and carry a copy of the prescription. Check the rules of the destination country before travel, because many countries restrict controlled medicines or require a permit.

Yes, but only with a valid prescription and only from a pharmacy licensed in your state. Many licensed pharmacies, including mail-order pharmacies run by insurers, fill pregabalin prescriptions online and ship them. Buying pregabalin from a website that does not require a prescription is illegal, and the product is often fake.[[5]][[7]]

steps: A clinician evaluates you in person or by telemedicine and decides whether pregabalin is appropriate.
The prescription goes to a pharmacy
Prescriptions for controlled medicines are usually sent electronically, straight from the prescriber to the pharmacy you choose.
The pharmacy checks and fills it
A pharmacist verifies the prescription and your identity, then dispenses the medicine in person or by mail.

blocks.p: **Signs that an online seller is illegal:**

ul: It sells pregabalin with no prescription, or after only a short online questionnaire.
It takes orders through social media, messaging apps, or email.
It asks for payment in cryptocurrency, gift cards, or money transfers.
It has no US street address, no state pharmacy license, and no pharmacist to speak to.
Its prices are far below those of ordinary pharmacies, or it ships from another country.

blocks.p: The FDA's BeSafeRx tool links to each state's license lookup, and the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy lists verified online pharmacies.[[5]][[6]]

blocks.p: Laws change and differ in detail. Check current rules before carrying any controlled medicine across a border.[[8]]

faq: Yes, in the US it is Schedule V, the lowest schedule, because it can be misused.
Is pregabalin the same as gabapentin?
They work the same way, but pregabalin is absorbed more predictably and is more potent per milligram. Gabapentin is not federally controlled.
Yes, in some people, along with swelling of the legs.
How long does pregabalin take to work for nerve pain?
Many people notice benefit within the first week.
